title: Green and efficient one-pot synthesis of the bio-based platform molecule 4-hydroxymethyl-2-furfural on a multigram scale
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00790E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kubilay Ceyhan, Mattis Rottmann, Harald Gröger
This study outlines a detailed process development of dendroketose preparation and its conversion to the bio-based platform molecule 4-hydroxymethyl-2-furfural (4-HMF) through a dehydration reaction in water as a green and sustainable solvent.
